title: CRASM-Gate: Deterministic-First Constraint- and Role-Aware Semantic Mapping with Selective Model Assistance Across Heterogeneous Industrial Standards
abstract: arXiv:2609.37458v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Industrial standards often encode the same engineering concept through incompatible hierarchies, identifiers, roles, and structural constraints, so the nearest lexical or embedding match can still be technically inadmissible. This article presents CRASM, a deterministic constraint- and role-aware semantic mapping method, and CRASM-Gate, its selectively model-assisted extension. The framework separates standard-specific canonicalization, bounded retrieval, deterministic rules, destination-versus-origin role interpretation, semantic and structural ranking, ambiguity refusal, and target validation. CRASM-Gate adds a confidence/disagreement gate that may invoke a candidate-constrained large language model, while final authority remains with deterministic validation. translated_title: CRASM-Gate：面向异构工业标准的确定性优先、约束与角色感知语义映射及选择性模型辅助
translated_abstract: 工业标准常常通过不兼容的层次结构、标识符、角色和结构约束来编码相同的工程概念，因此最近的词法或嵌入匹配在技术上仍可能是不可采纳的。本文提出了CRASM——一种确定性的约束与角色感知语义映射方法，以及其选择性模型辅助的扩展版本CRASM-Gate。该框架将标准特定的规范化、有界检索、确定性规则、目标与源的角色解释、语义与结构排序、歧义拒答以及目标验证相互分离。CRASM-Gate增加了一个置信度/分歧门控机制，可在必要时调用受候选约束的大语言模型，而最终裁决权仍然由确定性验证掌握。一项受控评估工件涵盖了六个有向的工业标准对、三个难度级别和十种配置，共产生了14,400个样本级的决策。在固定的本地m……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出确定性优先的约束与角色感知语义映射方法CRASM及其模型辅助扩展CRASM-Gate，通过置信度/分歧门控选择性调用大语言模型、同时保留确定性验证的最终裁决权，从而在异构工业标准之间实现技术可采纳的可靠语义映射。
en_tdlr: CRASM-Gate is a deterministic-first, constraint- and role-aware semantic mapping framework across heterogeneous industrial standards that selectively invokes a candidate-constrained LLM via a confidence/disagreement gate while keeping deterministic validation as the final authority.
